description: PB-32 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Nawanshahr sub-division within the Shahid Bhagat Singh Nagar district of Punjab. The office, managed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), is responsible for vehicle registrations, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations in the region.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Near Bus Stand, Nawanshahr, Punjab
